papers.title: Influence of process-induced microstructure and imperfections on mechanical properties of AlSi12 processed by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Higher Education Commission (HEC), H-9 Islamabad, Pakistan

corresponding_authors.name: Shafaqat Siddique
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Higher Education Commission (HEC), H-9 Islamabad, Pakistan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi12合金的选区激光熔化工艺，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on AlSi12 aluminum alloy for non-biomedical applications, with no porous structure, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or surface roughness relevant to osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对AlSi12合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 改变激光参数制备试样，进行微观表征和拉伸测试。
summary_zh.result: 工艺诱导的微观结构和缺陷显著影响强度与延展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证微观结构与力学性能的关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how selective laser melting process parameters influence the microstructure and mechanical properties of AlSi12 alloy.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated with varying laser parameters, followed by microstructural characterization and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Process-induced microstructure and imperfections significantly affect strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tensile tests correlated with microstructural observations to validate the relationships.

papers.title: Clinical assessment after total hip arthroplasty using the Japanese Orthopaedic Association Hip-Disease Evaluation Questionnaire
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kanazawa Medical University, Kahoku-gun, Ishikawa 920-0293, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Kiyokazu Fukui
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kanazawa Medical University, Kahoku-gun, Ishikawa 920-0293, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及临床评估问卷，未涉及任何生物力学或有限元建模内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or implant design; it is purely a clinical questionnaire study.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术后的临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 使用日本骨科协会髋关节疾病评估问卷进行调查。
summary_zh.result: 提供了术后临床功能评分。
summary_zh.validation: 无生物力学验证，仅为问卷结果统计。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate clinical outcomes after total hip arthroplasty using a disease-specific questionnaire.
summary_en.method: The Japanese Orthopaedic Association Hip-Disease Evaluation Questionnaire was administered to patients post-THA.
summary_en.result: Clinical function scores were obtained from questionnaire responses.
summary_en.validation: No biomechanical validation; the study reports only statistical analysis of questionnaire data.
